sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Survivalist Path - Cold Blooded is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come here, I've got a test for you. You must always maintain your composure, in every situation. You lose control or panic - you die. And no matter what happened - whether you've caught a bullet or just got drunk. But even with shaky hands, you have to shoot sharp. Prove to me that you can do this."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 2 PMC operatives with headshots while suffering from the tremor effect

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +5,900 EXP
- +1 Stress Resistance skill level
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 75,000 Roubles
  - 78,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 86,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"So you can even handle tremors? Great! To be honest, I didn't think you would succeed, the task was very difficult."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 2 PMC's with headshots while suffering from . Hands tremor is caused by 45 seconds of untreated pain. You can also use a SJ9 TGLabs combat stimulant injector to get the effect on demand.
